android.desc:
This application allows you to send and receive SMS messages to a US phone number anonymously for free with no ads.

Stop sharing your personal phone number with everyone—it opens the door to endless spam texts, unwanted promotions, hacking attempts, and phishing scams. With this app, you can keep your number private and secure by using a temporary, anonymous, and disposable SMS service to send and receive text messages.
